approaches.title: One-dimensional subset-sum dynamic programming
approaches.summary: Compute whether a subset can reach half of the total sum using a one-dimensional boolean DP array updated in reverse order. This determines whether the numbers can be partitioned into two equal-sum subsets.

revisions.commitComment: had to googs, why is dp so hard
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 416: had to googs, why is dp so hard
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduces a reverse-updated one-dimensional boolean DP targeting half the total sum, with an early exit when the target becomes reachable.

revisions.commitComment: better use of usize and tigher inner loop bounds
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 416: better use of usize and tigher inner loop bounds
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Keeps the same subset-sum DP strategy while using usize consistently, restricting the inner loop to valid indices, and returning immediately when the target is reached.
